nodes.description: Private owner address used as the privileged role for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate; whitelisted in ensure.
Public mapping of token balances mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping whitelist consulted by ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Address set by setTradeAddress and whitelisted in ensure.
Private sale count configured by init and enforced in condition.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balance/allowance of the deployer.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance protection.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and pair addresses before calling condition.
Internal view check enforcing sale count and min/max sale limits.
Public payable function restricted to owner that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and bytes.
Owner-restricted function initializing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from token amounts.
Owner-restricted batch transfer that multiplies _value by array length and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-restricted setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance ownership and balance mutation across the contract.
Low-level delegatecall executed inside delegate with attacker-supplied address and calldata, allowing arbitrary code execution in the token context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance decrement in transferFrom performed without SafeMath, enabling unsigned underflow.
total = _value * _tos.length and balance increments in batchSend executed without SafeMath, enabling overflow/underflow.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Array of recipient addresses passed to batchSend.
Address parameter stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit source address forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender key in allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
delegate authorizes execution solely through require(msg.sender == owner).
init authorizes configuration solely through require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend authorizes distribution solely through require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress authorizes the whitelist update solely through require(msg.sender == owner).
transfer returns the result of transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before mutating state.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the pool address compared against _from.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to an owner-supplied address, executing untrusted code in the token storage context.
transferFrom decrements allowance and balanceOf with unchecked -= enabling unsigned underflow.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length and adds balances without overflow checks.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
ensure reads owner to short-circuit the whitelist check.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass condition enforcement.
ensure reads tradeAddress when checking _from.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress stores addr into tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Parameter _from supplies the source account consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _value supplies the amount consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _to supplies the recipient consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
Parameter addr supplies the value stored by setTradeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only has meaning as the source account of the transferFrom function; collapse it into the function node.
The _value parameter is only consumed by transferFrom's arithmetic and bounds checks; collapse it into the function node.
The _to parameter is only consumed by transferFrom's balance credit; collapse it into the function node.
The _tos array is only iterated inside batchSend; collapse it into the function node.
The addr parameter is only stored by setTradeAddress; collapse it into the function node.
